- POC scope: 2-week dedicated cluster (reserved), compare 1) response latency & p95, 2) cost/token vs hosted, 3) failover behavior.

- Security asks: full SOC2 test report + Azure Key Vault integration pattern (they use AKV for customer secrets), contract language for EU residency.

- Internal stakeholders: VP Product (decision), Infra Lead (owns POC infra), Legal (procurement), Data Privacy officer (EU residency).
